evidence.summary: Round 3 threats: (1) '' flips from deny-all to open - any transaction a signed-in user runs without the listener would read open; mitigated by the per-transaction after_begin bind of both settings with '!' for no lines, apply_product_line_guc for the router's open transaction, and the only raw request-path connection being DDL-only; tested (mutation 18 vs 2). (2) Deployment ordering - the running round-2 API writes '' for no lines; the hand-off script restarts the API on the '!' code (0024-compatible) before the migration and refuses to migrate if the API does not come back healthy. (3) View re-creation dropping security_invoker - the refresh now creates it WITH (security_invoker = true) and asserts it. (4) Orphan product ids visible under open scopes (workers/admin) - accepted, matches pre-0024 behaviour. (5) Grant rows '*', '!' or comma - ignored for non-admins.

rationale: Each new trust change from 0025 has a control and a test or a scripted guard. Residuals unchanged from round 2 (user-triggered background jobs run as workers; admin compromise exposes all lines).
